lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
I walked into the room today
The colors started shifting shades
You turned around and caught my eye
The world just stopped, I wonder why
[chorus]
It's love at first sight, like a falling star
No matter where you go or where you are
The beat in my chest is skipping a sound
I'm lost in the magic that I have found
[verse]
I don't know your name, I don't know your past
But I feel a pull that is built to last
The air is static, the room is bright
Everything changes in the velvet light
[chorus]
It's love at first sight, like a falling star
No matter where you go or where you are
The beat in my chest is skipping a sound
I'm lost in the magic that I have found
[bridge]
They say it happens, they say it's rare
But suddenly I'm walking on the air
Gravity fades when you look at me
You're all that I ever want to see
[chorus]
It's love at first sight, like a falling star
No matter where you go or where you are
The beat in my chest is skipping a sound
I'm lost in the magic that I have found
[outro]
